shell.reasonTransactional: You received this email because it is about your %BRAND% account.
shell.reasonAlert: You received this email because you turned on job alerts in %BRAND%.
shell.reasonTips: You received this email because "Tips and reminders" is on in your %BRAND% settings.
shell.reasonMarketing: You received this email because you agreed to product news from %BRAND%.

billing.footer: You get this email because it is about your %BRAND% plan and payments.

renewalReminder.cancelLine: Don't want it to renew? Cancel any time before then in one click. Your paid features stay on until the end of the period you paid for.
renewalReminder.bodyManual: {plan} ends on {date}. It does not renew and nothing will be charged. Buy another pass if you want to keep Pro.
renewalReminder.bodyManualLegacy: {plan} ends on {date}. It does not renew and nothing will be charged. See the current plans if you want to keep practicing.

annualReminder.subject: Your %BRAND% subscription is still active
annualReminder.heading: A yearly check on your subscription
annualReminder.body: You have had {plan} since {since}. It renews every {period} for {price}. The next renewal is on {date}.

cancelLink.subject: Your link to cancel your %BRAND% plan
cancelLink.heading: Confirm your cancellation
cancelLink.body: Someone asked to cancel the %BRAND% plan for this email address. Use the button below within {minutes} minutes to confirm. The link works once.
cancelLink.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email. Nothing changes.

cancelNone.subject: No %BRAND% plan to cancel
cancelNone.heading: There is nothing to cancel
cancelNone.body: Someone asked to cancel a %BRAND% plan for this email address, but this account has no plan that renews. Nothing will be charged.

cancelConfirmed.subject: Your %BRAND% plan is cancelled
cancelConfirmed.heading: Your plan is cancelled
cancelConfirmed.body: We cancelled {plan}. It will not renew and you will not be charged again for it.
cancelConfirmed.accessUntil: Your paid features stay on until {date}. After that your account moves to Free.
cancelConfirmed.accessEnded: Your account is on Free now.

paymentFailed.subject: Your %BRAND% payment didn't go through
paymentFailed.heading: We couldn't charge your card
paymentFailed.body: The payment of {price} for {plan} failed. We will try again over the next few days.
paymentFailed.keep: Update your payment method to keep your plan. If the last try fails, your account moves to Free. Credits you already have stay yours.

studentCode.subject: Your %BRAND% student code: {code}
studentCode.preheader: Enter this code to confirm your school email.
studentCode.heading: Confirm your school email
studentCode.body: Enter this code in %BRAND% to confirm that you can read this inbox. It works for {minutes} minutes.
studentCode.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email. Nothing changes.

winback.subject: Your %BRAND% paid plan ended a month ago
winback.preheader: Your account and your work are still there.
winback.heading: Your account is still here
winback.body: Your paid plan ended on {date}. Your resumes, saved jobs and applications are still in your account, and the free plan keeps working.
winback.price: If you want Pro, it costs {price} every {period}. You can cancel any time.
winback.once: This is the only email we send about it.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your %BRAND% password
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: Someone asked to reset the password for this %BRAND% account. Use the button below to choose a new one. The link works once and expires in 30 minutes.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Your password stays the same.
passwordReset.sessions: Resetting your password signs you out on every other device.

emailVerify.subject: Confirm your email for %BRAND%
emailVerify.heading: Confirm your email
emailVerify.body: Confirm that this is your email address. You can keep using %BRAND% while you decide; confirming unlocks your free practice interview.
emailVerify.expiry: The link expires in 24 hours. You can send a new one from Settings.

oauthEmail.subject: Finish creating your %BRAND% account
oauthEmail.preheader: Confirm this email to finish signing up with LINE.
oauthEmail.heading: Finish signing up
oauthEmail.body: You started creating a %BRAND% account with LINE. Confirm this email address to finish. The account is created only after you click the button.
oauthEmail.ignore: If this was not you, ignore this email. No account is created.

newDevice.subject: New sign-in to your %BRAND% account
newDevice.heading: New sign-in
newDevice.body: Your account was just signed in to from {browser} on {os} at {time} (UTC).
newDevice.ifYou: If this was you, you do not need to do anything.
newDevice.ifNot: If this was not you, reset your password now. Resetting signs you out everywhere else.

otherBrand.subject: Someone tried to sign up with your email
otherBrand.heading: You already have an account
otherBrand.body: Someone tried to create a %BRAND% account with this email address. This email already belongs to a %OTHER_BRAND% account, and one email can hold only one of the two.
otherBrand.useOther: To keep using your account, sign in to %OTHER_BRAND%:
otherBrand.ignore: If this was not you, ignore this email. Nothing changed.

accountDeleted.subject: Your %BRAND% account is scheduled for deletion
accountDeleted.heading: Your account is scheduled for deletion
accountDeleted.body: You asked us to delete your %BRAND% account. You have been signed out everywhere and can no longer sign in.
accountDeleted.when: We delete your account and its data within {days} days. Backups are cleared within 90 days after that.
accountDeleted.notYou: If you did not ask for this, reply to this email or contact support right away.

bookingRequest.subject: Coaching request from {name}: {topic}
bookingRequest.heading: New coaching request
bookingRequest.intro: {name} would like a session with you, {coach}. They found you on the %BRAND% coach list.
bookingRequest.introAdmin: A user sent this request to {coach} from the %BRAND% coach list. This is your copy.
bookingRequest.addressUnverified: Typed by the user in the request form. %BRAND% has not checked that it is theirs.
bookingRequest.next: To accept, reply to this email or write to {email} to agree on a time and price.
bookingRequest.nextAdmin: The coach answers the user directly. Follow up if the coach asks for help.
bookingRequest.payment: The user pays the coach directly. %BRAND% takes no payment for coaching.
bookingRequest.reason: You get this email because you agreed to be listed as a coach on %BRAND% and a user asked for a session.
bookingRequest.reasonAdmin: You get this email because you look after the %BRAND% coach list.

dataExport.subject: Your %BRAND% data export is ready
dataExport.heading: Your data export is ready
dataExport.body: We put together a copy of your %BRAND% data. Sign in and open Settings → Privacy to download it. The file is deleted after {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.

growth.footer: You get this email because it is about credits on your %BRAND% account.

inviter.subject: A friend you invited finished setting up
inviter.heading: You got {credits, plural, one {# practice interview credit} other {# practice interview credits}}
inviter.body: A friend who signed up with your invite link has verified their account and finished setting up, so we added {credits, plural, one {# practice interview credit} other {# practice interview credits}} to your account.

invitee.subject: Your invite credit is ready
invitee.heading: You got {credits, plural, one {# practice interview credit} other {# practice interview credits}}
invitee.body: You joined with a friend's invite link and finished setting up, so we added {credits, plural, one {# practice interview credit} other {# practice interview credits}} to your account.

referralReward.note: Credits are for practice interviews on %BRAND%. They have no cash value.
